seoTitle: Import Amazon Reviews to Shopify for Free
metaDescription: Use a free app extension to pull Amazon product reviews into your Shopify store, boosting trust with reviews shoppers already recognize.
intro: Amazon reviews carry instant credibility because shoppers already trust the platform, and bringing that feedback into Shopify can boost conversions on your own store. This guide walks through setting up a free app extension, connecting it to the matching Amazon product page, and importing reviews with just a few clicks.

steps.heading: Set up the free app extension
steps.body: Install a free review-import app from the Shopify app store that supports pulling reviews from Amazon listings.

steps.heading: Connect the Amazon product page
steps.body: Point the app at the Amazon listing that matches your Shopify product so it knows which reviews to pull.

steps.heading: Import reviews into Shopify
steps.body: Run the import to bring the Amazon reviews directly onto your product page with minimal manual effort.

steps.heading: Customize imported reviews
steps.body: Adjust the display so the imported reviews fit your store's design and feel native to the page.

faq.question: Is importing Amazon reviews to Shopify free?
faq.answer: Yes, this method uses a free app extension, so there's no cost to import the reviews themselves.

faq.question: Why use Amazon reviews specifically?
faq.answer: Shoppers already recognize Amazon as a reliable source of verified feedback, which helps your Shopify store look more authentic instantly.

faq.question: Is this good for dropshippers?
faq.answer: Yes, it works well for both dropshippers and store owners who want genuine customer reviews without extra cost.

faq.question: How many clicks does it take to import reviews?
faq.answer: The process is designed to be quick, with the guide describing it as just a few clicks once the app and product page are connected.
